change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animated_size.rs: AnimatedSize::reverse_duration builder and reverse_duration_value getter; forwarded to the controller with set_reverse_duration at creation and on update.
harness: none; Flutter only runs the size animation forward, so no frame difference exists.
note: Reclassified from invalid: source compatibility is cheap here.

root_cause: No DeviceGestureSettings: every recognizer used kTouchSlop and kPanSlop regardless of the platform.
change: incular-core DeviceGestureSettings (touch_slop, pan_slop, from_physical); incular-gestures slop.rs compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop take settings, and the pointer, scale, tap-and-drag, multi-tap, multi-drag and force-press recognizers store them; incular-config RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings; incular-widgets tree gesture_settings_at hands the nearest MediaQuery settings to detector, scale and scroll-drag recognizers. trackpadScrollCausesScale was fixed in the gestures-api pass.
harness: gestures__ 11/11 match; no scenario overrides the slop.
api_change: added DeviceGestureSettings, RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings, public compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop and set_gesture_settings/gesture_settings on recognizers
limitations: No Android or iOS host exists to report a platform touch slop; desktop and web report none, as Flutter embedders do.

root_cause: The Router back dispatcher was a flat callback list with no child dispatchers, so a nested Router could not take priority.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/app_shell/router.rs: BackButtonDispatcher gains children and a parent (create_child, defer_to, forget, take_priority, has_callbacks); new ChildBackButtonDispatcher with take_priority; dispatch_back consults prioritized children newest first and then callbacks; dropping a child last callback forgets it; RouterConfig::with_back_button_dispatcher takes impl Into<BackButtonDispatcher>.
harness: none; no frame scenario drives Router back priority.
api_change: added ChildBackButtonDispatcher and BackButtonDispatcher child methods; RouterConfig::back_button_dispatcher returns Option<BackButtonDispatcher>

root_cause: No TransitionDelegate: the outlet animated every added page in and kept a replaced top under its replacement, regardless of the update.
change: crates/incular-navigation/src/transition_delegate.rs: TransitionDelegate, DefaultTransitionDelegate, PageTransition, PageRouteRecord, ExitingPageRoute, PageEntering, PageExiting, PageTransitionDecisions; Navigator::set_transition_delegate, clear_transition_delegate, take_page_transitions; set_pages builds the records with locations and runs the delegate outside the borrow. crates/incular-runtime/src/route_outlet.rs: drive_route_animations consumes the decisions; ExitPlacement replaces below/until.
harness: navigation__ 6/12, the same six documented divergences; no scenario drives set_pages.
api_change: added the transition delegate types and Navigator methods
limitations: Pageless routes do not exist in Incular, so Flutter pageRouteToPagelessRoutes has no counterpart. Complete and Remove both leave at once because routes carry no completion result.
note: Behavior change: set_pages now animates only the new top and drops a replaced top at once, as Flutter default does.

root_cause: CustomPainter had no semantics builder, so painted regions had no semantic nodes.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/custom_paint.rs: CustomPainter::semantics_builder (default None), CustomPainterSemantics (rect, key, Semantics properties), SemanticsBuilder; PainterDelegate keeps the builder. crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/painting.rs: CustomPaint adds a pointer-ignoring Positioned::fill LayoutBuilder layer per painter that places one Semantics node per region at the laid-out size, ordered background regions, child, foreground regions.
harness: new scenario semantics__custom_paint_regions: match; semantics__ 19/20 (enabled_default known), paint 9/9.
limitations: shouldRebuildSemantics, CustomPainterSemantics.transform and tags are not ported; regions rebuild with the widget.
